programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot

latest_verified_ci.note: Full L0->L3 regression green including strengthened alias containment, Ellis Experience/Satisfaction, Human Vision V1 and the new pull-away Human Vision policy boundary. Raw ShooterObservation bypass is rejected and unresolved streak/acquisition phases cannot generate precise target-point commands.

governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, PLANS, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
shooting_axiom: GOOD SHOOTING IS CONTINUOUS PERCEPTUAL COUPLING BETWEEN TARGET AND GUN: READ THE LINE -> MATCH THE SPEED -> APPLY THE METHOD -> TRIGGER -> FOLLOW THROUGH.
active_hypotheses: Good shooting is continuous perceptual coupling: read the live line, match gun speed, apply method, trigger, and follow through.
A demonstrated clay is a presentation prior rather than a deterministic trajectory; each live clay must be re-read as it varies with launch/aerodynamic/wind disturbance.

Binary reward support is sparse but demonstrably present in the pre-Human-Vision shooter-visible architecture; it must now be re-established under the stricter Human Vision pull-away policy before claiming learning support.

Ellis's complete apprenticeship — acquisition, perception, belief, intention, movement, outcome, self-diagnosis, intervention and later result — is scientifically valuable and should become a future causal training corpus for Chiron.

Shot Quality and Break Quality should remain distinct learner-visible assessments; Satisfaction is experimental and survives only if ablation improves held-out shooting outcomes or robust process without reward hacking.

Pull-away is the primary next-method learning hypothesis because acquire/connect/match/separate/trigger/follow-through creates an interpretable adaptation loop; maintained lead and swing-through remain comparators, not discarded methods.

A newly released fast clay should initially yield human-analogous transient/streak/region evidence and only later a resolved-but-uncertain track; expertise may improve expectation and interpretation but must not remove the sensory acquisition constraint.
Human-analogous acquisition should create a measurable information-versus-runway trade-off: waiting can improve line/speed belief but consumes shooting time and available movement.

Human kinematic limits, follow-through duration, coupling tolerances, visual acquisition timings, pursuit parameters and pull-away transition thresholds remain SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS / PROVISIONAL_METHOD_KINEMATICS pending Sense/video/eye-tracking calibration.
negative_findings: Static one-dimensional maintained-lead separation had no binary reward support after expanded diagnosis; motor travel was not the primary limitation.
A prior 40 ms belief-horizon/delay semantic bug and a 16.7 ms frame/state mismatch were corrected; corrected geometry/timing did not manufacture reward support.
Shooter-visible trigger timing expansion produced 100 physical follow-through shots across 1512 attempts and zero proxy hits.
Fresh post-geometry diagnostic produced 0/660 hits; quasi-continuous constant relationship exploration on seed base 361000 produced 0/1024 hits.

The first phase-dependent relationship diagnostic did not outperform its constant control: 4/1024 versus 5/1024 proxy hits on the same bank; phase-changing maintained lead is therefore not elevated to a universal rule.
Reward support is population-sensitive and sparse; do not post-hoc tune to rewarded action identities.
Do not widen the hit proxy, inject referee miss gradients, expose oracle lead, or treat the 55 mm engineering proxy as real-world break probability.
Satisfaction is not yet evidence-backed as a useful learner objective.
Human Vision V1 numerical defaults and pull-away policy thresholds are not established clay-shooting physiology and must not be presented as universal human constants.
next_action: Build the first human-vision-constrained pull-away episode/evaluation runner on explicit non-sealed train/calibration/held-out crosser populations. Incrementally build ELLIS_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_V1, operate the finite gun plant only through PULL_AWAY_HUMAN_VISION_POLICY_STATE_V1, oracle-score only after a learner-generated trigger, and return HIT_MISS_ONLY_FEEDBACK_V1 in the first condition. Persist ELLIS_EXPERIENCE_RECORD_V1 including ELLIS_ACQUISITION_EXPERIENCE_V1. Use interpretable separation exploration/memory without initialising from prior rewarded action identities or oracle geometry. First establish reproducible binary reward support under Human Vision V1; then compare memory ON/OFF, Satisfaction ON/OFF, human vision vs legacy clean-point, and selective wait ON/OFF on distinct train/calibration/held-out populations. Do not scale to 100k until held-out learning is demonstrated.
